rows.note: Tone is now right: keep it. But a blind re-read (5 independent reads each, a different model, told nothing) named the lean 5/5 and never the rival, so each row is one-sided (tools/cluegates/blind_reread.md, NEVER_RIVAL). The pieces and first line give the side away on their own (a radio and a callback read only as a failed response; sprayer, fertilizer and filter read only as the program). The lean should come from where it is placed and from one detail, with the rival reading genuinely live: a reader told nothing should sometimes pick the other side. Rework title, body and if needed pieces; keep place, spot, lean and axioms.

row.body: A caller tried twice before her shift ended at seven. The road channel went uncovered at six; the callback stayed open until a supervisor could initial the box.
row.title: Call awaiting initials
row.gloss: A field call is deferred while the road channel lacks coverage.
row.rival_reading: The call may have concerned routine field work; a missed handoff alone does not show that officials knew of a wider emergency.

row.body: The field worker missed the last bus home while the sprayer and fertilizer stayed on hold until the filter's condition was entered. The release box remained blank until morning.
row.title: Filter condition before release
row.gloss: Agricultural supplies remain grouped with a filter and go uncollected overnight.
row.rival_reading: The items may have been held as an ordinary precaution during containment; an unclaimed supply set does not establish that the program caused an exposure.
